summary: Ansible 14 community.general deprecations: aix_devices, aix_filesystem, aix_inittab, aix_lvg and aix_lvol are superseded by the ibm.power_aix collection (removed in 15.0.0), and datadog_monitor mute and unmute states are replaced by community.general.datadog_downtime.
questions: What replaces the community.general aix modules?
How do I mute a Datadog monitor now?
